brief:
A young mother in Gaza has been widowed twice and lost two children during the ongoing conflict, Al Jazeera English reported. The woman's story is one among thousands of Palestinians who have faced multiple bereavements and family separations across generations during Israel's military operations in Gaza.

Civilian casualties have mounted throughout the war, with many survivors carrying the weight of successive losses within their families.
dek: A young mother has lost two husbands and two children during Israel's genocidal war on Gaza.
title: Gaza mother loses two husbands and two children in war
